_doc: Objectives shown in the top-left corner, per zone. An objective is done when its flag is set. 'after' hides it until that flag is set (unless it is already done). {name} is replaced by Game.counters[name].

bedroom.text: Watch the video on the PC
Take the notebook from the desk

city.text: When you've had enough: wake up (hold T)

deep.text: Find the DRAIN lever's missing handle
Watch the deep pool until it's empty
Find the key to the gate around the deep pool

seabed.text: Follow the glowing stones. Don't stray.

compression.text: Find 3 fuses for the freight elevator ({fuses}/3)
Put the fuses in the fuse box

above.text: Get the key at the end of the plank
Cross the beam to the next roof
Use the key on the bridge controls
Climb the mast to the light
